race.description: Spring Racing Carnival Book Now Hcp (Bm78)
race.comment: CAPTAIN MAVERICK (3) has become quite the bridesmaid and is proving costly for his supporters, but the talent is there. Strikes another suitable contest and keeps Maloney from a better draw this time. No reason he can't stick out the head this time. SOCIAL OUTCAST (2) meets both CAPTAIN MAVERICK & DEMARCAY better at the weights this time after a strong chasing effort behind them last time. Drawn cosy and can turn the tables. The winner DEMARCAY (5) warrants obvious respect and should be giving himself every chance again up on speed. Youngberry's 3kg claim keeps him a serious hope. BARAZIN (1) is doing little wrong and will be hoping this pace is genuine so he can finish off strong. TARAVIA (6) has made a strong return and gets in at featherweight with Thompson reuniting. Not underestimating.
